hooks.command: bash -c 'SCRIPT=".claude/scripts/hooks/warning-messages.sh"; if [[ -x "$SCRIPT" ]]; then "$SCRIPT" tdd-reminder "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; else if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.py ]] && [[ ! -f "tests/test_$(basename $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH)" ]]; then echo "Warning: No test file found. Consider TDD - write tests first!"; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" == *"git push"* ]]; then SCRIPT=".claude/scripts/hooks/warning-messages.sh"; if [[ -x "$SCRIPT" ]]; then "$SCRIPT" push-quality 2>/dev/null || true; else echo "Quality check: Ensure tests pass before pushing."; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'SCRIPT=".claude/scripts/hooks/warning-messages.sh"; if [[ -x "$SCRIPT" ]]; then "$SCRIPT" file-written "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; else echo "File written: $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'SCRIPT=".claude/scripts/issue-tracker.sh"; if [[ -x "$SCRIPT" ]]; then if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" == *"git commit"* ]]; then MSG=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE "\-m [\"'\'']\'"'"'[^\"'\'']*[\"'\'']\'"'"'" | head -1 | sed "s/-m [\"'\'']\'"'"'//;s/[\"'\'']\'"'"'$//"); "$SCRIPT" on-commit "$MSG" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi; exit 0'
bash -c 'SCRIPT=".claude/scripts/issue-tracker.sh"; if [[ -x "$SCRIPT" ]]; then if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" == *"git push"* ]]; then "$SCRIPT" on-push 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'SCRIPT=".claude/scripts/issue-tracker.sh"; if [[ -x "$SCRIPT" ]]; then if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" == *"gh pr create"* ]]; then PR_NUM=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -oE "#[0-9]+" | head -1 | tr -d "#"); PR_TITLE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE "--title [\"'\'']\'"'"'[^\"'\'']*[\"'\'']\'"'"'" | head -1 | sed "s/--title [\"'\'']\'"'"'//;s/[\"'\'']\'"'"'$//"); [[ -n "$PR_NUM" ]] && "$SCRIPT" on-pr "$PR_NUM" "$PR_TITLE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'SCRIPT=".claude/scripts/issue-tracker.sh"; if [[ -x "$SCRIPT" ]]; then if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" =~ (npm test|bun test|yarn test|pnpm test|pytest|jest|vitest|cargo test|go test) ]]; then "$SCRIPT" on-tests "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT" | grep -qiE "deploy|release|production"; then SCRIPT=".claude/scripts/hooks/warning-messages.sh"; if [[ -x "$SCRIPT" ]]; then "$SCRIPT" deploy-gate 2>/dev/null || true; else echo "Deployment requested - ensure all quality gates pass."; fi; fi; exit 0'
bash -c 'SCRIPT=".claude/scripts/issue-tracker.sh"; if [[ -x "$SCRIPT" ]]; then echo "Issue tracking status:"; "$SCRIPT" status 2>/dev/null || true; fi; exit 0'
